title: Ledger record envelope (shared by L1-L10)
description: arch §5.2: structured records (timestamp, agent identity, action, context), tamper-evident via cryptography; fork FK2: hash-chaining on all ledgers. Every ledger record carries this envelope.

record_id.description: Unique id of this ledger record

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the event

schema_version.description: Version of the ledger schema this record was written under

agent_id.description: Identity of the agent/component that wrote the record (arch §5.2 practitioner bar)

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous record in this ledger file (null for genesis) — FK2 hash-chaining

hash.description: Hash of this record's canonical serialization including prev_hash — tamper-evidence (arch §5.2)

ref.description: Content-by-reference pointer (arch §5 minimization: content stored externally with references, never inline)

path.description: Path or locator within the store

content_hash.description: Hash of the referenced content (chain hashes references — fork SE-2)
